summary: The identity move proves every part correctly, and setup steps say clearly when they wait on you.

fixes.title: Identity move proves each part correctly
fixes.text: The identity move now proves the updater and the web front correctly after they move to their new identity.

fixes.title: Clearer waiting status for setup steps
fixes.text: A setup step that waits on a support ticket now says waiting for the customer, with the ticket number, instead of showing a gap.

fixes.title: Approved exceptions are named
fixes.text: One job can keep its old identity by an owner-approved exception, and the identity check names it.
